QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_47

question.text: The CTR disclosure on 'Fund raising' confirms that an AIF may raise funds:

answer.text: Through public advertisements on broadcast media
Only by way of a private placement mechanism
By listing units on a recognized stock exchange

explanation.text: The Logic: CTR row on Fund Raising: 'An AIF can raise funds only by way of a PRIVATE PLACEMENT mechanism.' Public advertisements / listing / crowdfunding are NOT permitted channels. The CTR requires the AIF to confirm this and specify the method. The Trap: Public advertising (A), listing (C), crowdfunding (D) are all non-compliant with the private-placement rule. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-B (Cat III Distributor) tests private-placement framework at distribution level. XIX-C/D test at manager level. Manager's Pro-Tip: Do not run digital marketing campaigns with subscription forms — that violates the private-placement rule. Use targeted outreach to accredited/institutional prospects with proper KYC and subscription docs.
